posts.hook: Anthropic's IPO paperwork quietly priced in all of knowledge work
posts.caption: the wsj reads anthropic's s-1 as sizing its market at over $40 trillion a year, a 9.5-severity firmware flaw touches most servers, amd puts $1 billion into meta's stock raise. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic's IPO filing implies a ==$40T== yearly market
slides.desc: The WSJ reads it as the value of all knowledge work, above SpaceX's $28.5T

slides.title: A 9.5-severity flaw sits in the firmware code behind most servers
slides.desc: It runs code before Secure Boot and OS defenses start

terms.gloss: a check that only trusted code loads when a computer starts

slides.title: AMD puts $1 billion into Meta's stock raise, joining Nvidia
slides.desc: With Nvidia that is $4B of chipmaker cash into one customer

slides.title: Claude gets a 40% discount for all levels of government
slides.desc: State and city agencies join federal ones, with ==$1B== in estimated savings

slides.title: Claude is moving into drug labs
slides.desc: Six biotech partnerships, with an 89% cut in review time cited

posts.hook: Google's newest model goes to bug hunters before anyone else
posts.caption: google unveils gemini 4 carbon and claims the top spot on a new benchmark, apple shows a touchscreen macbook pro, github reports 7.4 billion commits a month. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, built for security and long coding runs
slides.desc: Early access goes to vetted defenders first, and Google claims the #1 spot on a new index

slides.title: Apple ships a touchscreen MacBook Pro, the Mac it said would never happen
slides.desc: From $2,899, with M5 Pro or M5 Max chips, available November 6

slides.title: GitHub now sees ==7.4B== commits a month, up from 2.9B in August
slides.desc: It added 4M CPU cores and 160PB of storage this year to keep up with agents

slides.title: GitHub's Copilot Fusion picks the model for you, and is now generally available
slides.desc: Reportedly near Opus 5.5 quality at half the cost, routing between Claude and GPT

slides.title: The new Artificial Analysis index is mostly private tests, so it is harder to game
slides.desc: Claude Opus 5.5 (max) led it at 58 when it launched

terms.gloss: an independent group that scores and ranks AI models
